name: expense-exchange
author: Denis Zholob
description: Tool to keep track of expenses for multiple people

scripts.dev:desktop: pnpm run build:desktop:renderer && pnpm run build:desktop:compile && electron .
scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:storybook && pnpm run build:desktop && pnpm run build:docker
scripts.build:client: pnpm run patchModifyDate && ng build client && pnpm run stamp:build-info -- .dist/client/browser/index.html
scripts.build:web: pnpm run patchModifyDate && ng build client --configuration production --base-href=/ --output-path=.builds/expense-exchange-v${npm_package_version}/expense-exchange-v${npm_package_version}-web && pnpm run stamp:build-info -- .builds/expense-exchange-v${npm_package_version}/expense-exchange-v${npm_package_version}-web/browser/index.html && pnpm run build:screenshots
scripts.build:desktop:renderer: pnpm run patchModifyDate && ng build client --base-href=./ && pnpm run stamp:build-info -- .dist/client/browser/index.html
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run build:desktop:renderer && pnpm run build:desktop:compile && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.json && node --experimental-strip-types tools/stage-electron-build/stage-electron-build.script.ts
scripts.build:desktop:unpacked: pnpm run build:desktop:renderer && pnpm run build:desktop:compile && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.json --dir && node --experimental-strip-types tools/stage-electron-build/stage-electron-build.script.ts --dir
scripts.build:desktop:linux: pnpm run build:desktop:renderer && pnpm run build:desktop:compile && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.json --linux && node --experimental-strip-types tools/stage-electron-build/stage-electron-build.script.ts linux
scripts.build:desktop:windows: pnpm run build:desktop:renderer && pnpm run build:desktop:compile && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.json --win && node --experimental-strip-types tools/stage-electron-build/stage-electron-build.script.ts win
scripts.build:desktop:macos: pnpm run build:desktop:renderer && pnpm run build:desktop:compile && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.json --mac && node --experimental-strip-types tools/stage-electron-build/stage-electron-build.script.ts mac
scripts.build:docker: pnpm run build:api && pnpm run build:client && pnpm run docker:build && pnpm run docker:package
scripts.build:gh-prod: pnpm run patchModifyDate && ng build client --base-href=/expense-exchange/ && pnpm run stamp:build-info -- .dist/client/browser/index.html
scripts.generate:api: pnpm run build:server && node --experimental-strip-types tools/generate-api/generate-api.script.ts && pnpm exec orval --config ./orval.config.ts && pnpm exec prettier --write src/client/api/generated
